mentions.name: nvim-raccoon
mentions.description: A Neovim plugin that aims to make code review actually enjoyable, bringing code review workflows into the editor.
mentions.problem: Code review is unenjoyable, even though developers will spend most of their time on it.
mentions.audience: Developers who spend much of their time reviewing code
mentions.source_excerpt:
Nvim plugin that tries to make code review actually enjoyable (as I think this is what we will spend most of our time on).
